text:
Sam: spotted an S3 object in partner-ci (s3://partner-ci/ci/out/workspace_blob.bin) that begins with `vault:v1:` and contains `aws-kms:` metadata. Looks like Vault transit wrapped a KMS envelope.
sec-bot: Alert: external-object-read detected (rule:s3-external-access). Created incident 1795552222.
Maya: paste path + sanitized header please (no plaintext).
Sam: s3://partner-ci/ci/out/workspace_blob.bin -> header `vault:v1:aa11bb... || aws-kms:arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01`
Luis: nested envelope = higher blast radius. Anyone with transit/unwrap and KMS decrypt could recover plaintext. Check any onboarding bindings for partner CI.
Ops: confirming the partner CI SA had read perms via onboarding binding in infra-onboard (expires 2026-09). Taking containment actions now.
Ops: commands run:
  gcloud projects remove-iam-policy-binding infra-onboard --member="serviceAccount:partner-ci@partner-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com" --role="roles/storage.objectViewer"
  gcloud iam service-accounts keys list --iam-account=partner-ci@partner-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com || true
  gcloud iam service-accounts keys delete KEY_ID --iam-account=partner-ci@partner-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com || true
  aws s3 cp s3://partner-ci/ci/out/workspace_blob.bin s3://sec-quarantine/1795552222/workspace_blob.bin --profile=infra-admin
  aws s3 rm s3://partner-ci/ci/out/workspace_blob.bin --profile=infra-admin
Maya: enable Vault transit audit and push logs to central.
Maya: vault audit enable file file_path=/var/log/vault_transit_audit.log
Maya: search for transit/unwraps referencing partner SA: 
  cat /var/log/vault_transit_audit.log | jq -c 'select(.path|contains("transit/unwrap"))' | grep partner-ci || true
Luis: also check CloudTrail for KMS Decrypt/GenerateDataKey calls for key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01.
Luis: aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=ResourceName,AttributeValue=arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01 --max-results 50
Sam: quick scan across partner buckets for `vault:v1:` and `aws-kms:` markers. Found 3 objects total. Uploaded scrubbed list to /sec/artifacts/1795552222-objects.txt (no plaintext).
Ops: containment done: binding revoked, partner SA keys disabled, objects quarantined. Handoff to EngSec for rotation.
Maya: rotation plan: 1) forced rotate Vault transit key 2) rewrap quarantined artifacts 3) if CloudTrail shows KMS decrypts by unexpected principals -> rotate CMK and treat inner envelopes as suspect 4) tighten Vault policy so decrypt/unwrap is explicit to internal services only.
Luis: sample rotate/rewrap commands: 
  vault write -f transit/keys/app-transit-key/rotate
  vault write transit/rewrap ciphertext="<old-cipher>" key="app-transit-key"
Maya: audit slice shows failed unwrap attempts (403) from partner SA on 2026-03-19 and 2026-03-21; no successful unwraps so far. Still proceed with rotations.
Sam: contacted partner SOC and Legal with scrubbed keys and actions taken. Legal: please prep standard partner notification.
Legal: acknowledged. Provide timeline + containment evidence (copy commands, checksums).
Ops: checksums for quarantined objects uploaded to /sec/artifacts/1795552222-checksums.txt.
Maya: owners & next steps:
  - Sam: finish full scan across partner projects and update artifact list (ETA 2h)
  - Luis: CloudTrail KMS forensics + determine if CMK used by unexpected principals (ETA 3h)
  - Ops: coordinate transit rotate & rewrap (canary->prod) (ETA 4h)
Maya: scheduling 60m post-rotation review tomorrow 16:00 UTC to validate rewrap proofs, KMS forensics, and RBAC changes.
Luis: if KMS shows abuse, plan CMK rotation + re-encrypt owners will be notified; if we can't re-encrypt inner envelopes, mark affected artifacts as invalid.
Sam: running overnight scan and will post results here. Thanks team :lock:
